questions.q: Which of the following is NOT plagiarism?
options: Submitting an essay written by someone else as one's own
Copying paragraphs from a website without acknowledgement
Quoting a passage in quotation marks with a proper citation of the source
Presenting another researcher's idea in your own words without crediting them
questions.exp: Properly quoted and cited material acknowledges the source; the others pass off others' work as one's own.

questions.q: Which option correctly shows the proper containment of language classes?
questions.exp: The Chomsky hierarchy is Type 3 ⊂ Type 2 ⊂ Type 1 ⊂ Type 0.

questions.q: An ε-NFA has transitions q0 --ε--> q1, q1 --ε--> q2 and q2 --a--> q3. How many states are in ε-closure(q0)?
questions.exp: From q0 we reach q1 and q2 by ε moves, so the closure is {q0, q1, q2}.

questions.q: The primary purpose of a Virtual Private Network (VPN) is to
options: Increase the physical bandwidth of the link
Assign IP addresses dynamically to hosts
Create an encrypted tunnel for private communication over a public network
questions.exp: A VPN uses tunnelling and encryption so that data crossing the Internet stays confidential.

questions.q: Match the IT Act sections: (i) 66E (ii) 66F (iii) 67B (iv) 66D with (p) cyber terrorism (q) cheating by personation using a computer resource (r) child sexually explicit material (s) violation of privacy.
questions.exp: 66E is privacy violation, 66F cyber terrorism, 67B child pornography and 66D cheating by personation.

questions.q: In natural language processing, stemming refers to
options: finding the meaning of a sentence
reducing a word to its root form
questions.exp: Stemming strips affixes, e.g. 'playing' and 'played' become 'play'.

questions.q: How many 3-to-8 decoders (with enable input) are needed to build a 4-to-16 decoder?
questions.exp: The 4th input bit drives the enables of two decoders (one directly, one inverted), giving 2 × 8 = 16 outputs.

questions.q: Which device can interconnect networks that use different protocols and architectures?
questions.exp: A gateway performs protocol conversion and can connect dissimilar networks.

questions.q: If T(n) = T(n−1) + n with T(1) = 1, then T(10) equals

questions.exp: 8051 vectors: INT0 0003H, Timer 0 000BH, INT1 0013H, Timer 1 001BH, Serial 0023H.

questions.q: The array 4 10 3 5 1 is converted into a max-heap using the bottom-up heapify method. What is the resulting array?
questions.exp: Heapify 10 (fine); heapify 4: swap with 10 giving 10 4 3 5 1, then 4 swaps with 5 giving 10 5 3 4 1.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a hard real-time system?
options: An aircraft flight-control or pacemaker controller
questions.exp: In hard real-time systems missing a deadline is a failure; streaming is soft real-time.

questions.q: The greedy choice of taking items in decreasing order of value-to-weight ratio gives an optimal solution for
questions.exp: Ratio-greedy is optimal only when items can be split.

questions.q: In Java, the super keyword is used to refer to:
questions.exp: super refers to the immediate superclass's members and constructors.

questions.q: Which ISO/IEC standard defines the software life cycle processes?
questions.exp: ISO/IEC 12207 establishes a framework of processes for the software life cycle; the others deal with environment, security and food safety.

questions.q: In the pumping lemma for regular languages with pumping length p, a long string w is split as xyz. Which conditions must hold?
questions.exp: The lemma requires y to be non-empty and the loop to occur within the first p symbols.

questions.q: A C program is run as ./a.out x y z. What is the value of argc?
questions.exp: argc counts the program name too: a.out, x, y, z = 4 (argv[0] is the program name).

questions.q: Which of the following is a professional networking website?
questions.exp: LinkedIn is designed for professional networking and recruitment.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Wireless LANs use CSMA/CA instead of CSMA/CD.
Reason (R): A wireless station cannot reliably detect collisions while it is transmitting.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.exp: Transmit and receive power levels differ greatly, so collision detection is impractical; hence collision avoidance is used.
c is shared by all objects; three constructor calls make it 3.

questions.q: Which SQL command removes all rows of a table quickly while keeping its structure for future use?
questions.exp: TRUNCATE TABLE deletes all rows and keeps the table definition; DROP TABLE removes the table itself.

questions.q: DHCP servers listen for client requests using which transport protocol and port?
questions.exp: DHCP uses UDP; the server uses port 67 and the client uses port 68.

questions.q: Daisy chaining in an interrupt system is used for
options: Resolving priority among several interrupting devices
questions.exp: Devices are connected in series; the one nearest the CPU gets the highest priority.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
L = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
L[1:4] = [9]
del L[0]
print(L)
questions.exp: Slice assignment gives [1,9,5,6]; deleting index 0 leaves [9,5,6].

questions.q: After executing XRA A in an 8085 program, the Zero and Carry flags are
questions.exp: A XOR A = 0, so Z = 1; XRA always clears CY.

questions.q: In PHP, the function session_start() must be called:
options: only after the HTML body has been printed
before any output is sent to the browser, because it sends an HTTP header
questions.exp: session_start() sets the PHPSESSID cookie header, so it must come before any HTML or echo output.

questions.q: Which cache mapping technique needs no replacement algorithm because each memory block maps to exactly one line?
questions.exp: In direct mapping a block has a single possible line, so there is no choice of victim.

questions.q: A backup that copies only the files changed since the last FULL backup is called a(n):
questions.exp: Differential backups copy changes since the last full backup, so restore needs the full backup plus the latest differential. Incremental copies changes since the last backup of any kind.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
print([x * y for x in range(1, 4) for y in range(x, 4) if (x + y) % 2 == 0])
questions.exp: Pairs with even sum: (1,1),(1,3),(2,2),(3,3) giving 1,3,4,9.

questions.q: In an ER diagram, total participation of an entity set in a relationship is shown by
questions.exp: A double line from the entity to the relationship means every entity must participate; a single line means partial participation.

questions.q: A well-formed XML document must have:
questions.exp: Well-formedness requires a single root element, properly nested and closed tags.

questions.q: Which of the following is a checked exception in Java?
questions.exp: IOException is checked and must be caught or declared; the others are RuntimeExceptions.

questions.q: In the bounded-buffer producer-consumer solution with a buffer of N slots, the semaphores empty, full and mutex are initialised respectively to:
questions.exp: empty counts free slots (N), full counts filled slots (0) and mutex guards buffer access (1).

questions.q: How many point-to-point links are required to connect 8 nodes in a fully connected mesh topology?
The World Wide Web was proposed and developed at CERN by:
questions.exp: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the Web at CERN in 1989-90.

questions.q: HDLC bit stuffing is applied to the data 0111111 (flag = 01111110). What is transmitted?
questions.exp: After five consecutive 1s the sender inserts a 0: 0 11111 [0] 1 = 01111101, so the data can never imitate the flag.

questions.q: A 4-bit serial-in right-shift register initially holds 0000. The bits 1, 0, 1, 1 are applied serially (in that order, first bit first) with one bit per clock. After 4 clocks the register (Q3 Q2 Q1 Q0, input enters Q3) contains
questions.exp: Shifting right each time: 1000 → 0100 → 1010 → 1101.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a desirable characteristic of an algorithm?
options: Having zero or more inputs and at least one output
questions.exp: Every step of an algorithm must be precisely defined; ambiguity is not allowed.

questions.q: A Go-Back-N protocol uses 3-bit sequence numbers. What is the maximum sender window size?
questions.exp: For Go-Back-N the maximum window is 2ⁿ − 1 = 2³ − 1 = 7.

questions.q: Why can a Java class achieve a form of multiple inheritance through interfaces?
options: A class can implement more than one interface
A class can extend two interfaces
questions.exp: A class may implement any number of interfaces, thereby inheriting several types.

questions.q: In the output of ls -l, a line beginning with the character 'd' (for example drwxr-xr-x) represents:
questions.exp: The first character shows the file type: d for directory, - for regular file, l for symbolic link.

questions.q: A branch instruction uses PC-relative addressing. The PC (already incremented) holds 1000 and the offset field is +24. The effective address is
questions.exp: Effective address = PC + offset = 1000 + 24 = 1024.

questions.q: By default, CoAP (Constrained Application Protocol) runs over which transport protocol?
questions.exp: CoAP is a lightweight REST-like protocol designed for constrained devices and uses UDP.

questions.q: The keys 50, 30, 70, 20, 40, 60, 80, 35 are inserted in this order into an empty BST. What is the height of the tree (counted in edges)?
questions.exp: The path 50 -> 30 -> 40 -> 35 has 3 edges and is the longest.

questions.q:
Match the file method with its action:
(i) read(4)  (ii) readline()  (iii) readlines()  (iv) seek(0)
(a) returns the remaining lines as a list  (b) moves the pointer to the start  (c) returns a single line  (d) returns the next 4 characters
questions.exp: read(n) reads n characters, readline() one line, readlines() all lines as a list, seek(0) rewinds.

questions.q: A grammar in Chomsky normal form derives a string of length 5 (no ε). How many derivation steps are needed?
questions.exp: A string of length n needs n-1 binary productions and n terminal productions, so 2n - 1 = 9 steps.

questions.q: Files on a company server are renamed with a strange extension and a note demands payment in cryptocurrency for the decryption key. This malware is
questions.exp: Ransomware encrypts victim data and demands a ransom.
a.length is the number of rows (3) and a[0].length the number of columns in row 0 (4). Output: 3 4.

questions.q: In STRIPS-style planning, an action is described by its
options: heuristic value and path cost only
preconditions, add list and delete list
questions.exp: STRIPS actions list preconditions that must hold, facts added and facts deleted by the action.

questions.q: A static program analysis tool
options: Examines source code without executing it to detect potential defects
Executes the program with test data to measure statement coverage
Measures the response time of a running application under load
Automatically generates the graphical user interface
questions.exp: Static analysis inspects code (e.g., for uninitialized variables, unreachable code) without running it.

questions.q: Which of the following is the IPv4 loopback address?
questions.exp: The 127.0.0.0/8 block is reserved for loopback; 127.0.0.1 is the standard address.

questions.q: In C++, the copy constructor is invoked when:
options: An object is passed by reference to a function
An object is passed by value to a function
A pointer to an object is declared
questions.exp: Passing by value creates a copy of the argument, calling the copy constructor.

questions.q: In throw-away (rapid) prototyping, the prototype is:
options: discarded after the requirements have been clarified
questions.exp: The throw-away prototype is built to elicit and validate requirements and is then discarded; the real system is built with proper design. Evolutionary prototyping instead refines the prototype into the product.

questions.q: Table Emp(dept) holds the values CS, EE, CS, ME, EE, NULL. What does SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dept) FROM Emp return?
questions.exp: The distinct non-NULL values are CS, EE and ME, so the count is 3. COUNT(column) and COUNT(DISTINCT column) ignore NULL values.

questions.q:
Statement I: A primary key attribute cannot contain NULL values.
Statement II: A relation can have more than one primary key but only one candidate key.
Which is correct?
options: Statement I is true and Statement II is false
Statement I is false and Statement II is true
questions.exp: Entity integrity forbids NULL in a primary key. A relation has exactly one primary key but may have several candidate keys, so II is false.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
def f():
    try:
        return 1
    finally:
        print("F")
print(f())
questions.exp: The finally block runs before the function actually returns, so F is printed first, then 1.

questions.q: Which problem of cloud-only IoT is reduced by edge/fog computing?
options: High latency and bandwidth use because all raw data travels to a distant data centre
questions.exp: Edge/fog nodes process data near the device, giving faster response and cutting bandwidth.

questions.q: Which statement about memory-mapped I/O is correct?
options: It uses only the IN and OUT instructions
The number of ports is limited to 256
I/O devices are treated like memory locations, so memory-reference instructions can be used on them
It does not reduce the memory space available for memory
questions.exp: In memory-mapped I/O devices share the memory address space, so any memory instruction (MOV, ADD, etc.) can access them, at the cost of memory space.

questions.exp: Each R tuple matches exactly one S tuple (B is unique in S and every R.B exists in S), so the join has 4 tuples.

questions.q: A recursive binary search on n sorted elements uses auxiliary stack space of
questions.exp: Each call halves the range, so the recursion depth is about log2 n and each frame is O(1).

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
class K:
    n = 0
    def __init__(self):
        K.n += 1
a = K()
b = K()
print(a.n, K.n)
questions.exp: n is a class variable shared by all instances. Each constructor increments it, so it is 2; a.n looks it up on the class, also 2.

questions.q: The running time of an algorithm satisfies T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n. Which is its complexity?
questions.exp: By the master theorem a=2, b=2, f(n)=n = n^(log₂2), giving Θ(n log n).

questions.q: Physical data independence refers to the ability to
options: add new attributes without changing application programs
change the physical storage structures or access paths without changing the conceptual schema
change the external views without changing storage
run programs on any hardware without recompilation
questions.exp: Physical data independence means changes at the internal (storage) level do not require changes in the conceptual schema.

questions.q: An Aadhaar number issued by UIDAI consists of how many digits?
questions.exp: Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identification number.

questions.q: A UART in a microcontroller is used for
questions.exp: The Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter sends and receives serial frames with start and stop bits and no shared clock.

questions.q: A digital signature is created by encrypting the message digest with the
questions.exp: Only the sender holds the private key, so anyone can verify the signature with the sender's public key.

questions.q: In a microprogrammed control unit, the microinstructions are stored in
questions.exp: Microprograms reside in a special, usually ROM, control memory.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT stored in the inode of a Unix file?
questions.exp: The file name is stored in the directory entry, which maps the name to an inode number.

questions.q: A backtracking program generates all permutations of 4 distinct letters. How many complete permutations (leaf nodes) does its search tree have?
questions.exp: The first position has 4 choices, the next 3, then 2, then 1: 4! = 24 leaves.

questions.q: A model that gives very high accuracy on training data but much lower accuracy on unseen test data is said to be
questions.exp: Overfitting means the model memorises training data, including noise, and fails to generalise.

questions.q: Why must a DRAM be refreshed periodically?
options: Its flip-flops lose state when the clock stops
The charge stored on its capacitors leaks away
questions.exp: A DRAM cell is one transistor plus a capacitor; leakage means every row must be rewritten every few milliseconds. SRAM flip-flops need no refresh.

questions.q: Which value of the CSS position property positions an element relative to the browser viewport and keeps it in place while scrolling?
questions.exp: position: fixed is positioned relative to the viewport and does not move on scroll.

questions.q: In a multistage graph S→{A,B}→{C,D}→T with costs S-A 2, S-B 3, A-C 4, A-D 1, B-C 2, B-D 5, C-T 3, D-T 6, the minimum cost from S to T is
For a 3-bit even-parity generator with inputs A, B and C, the parity bit P is given by
questions.exp: The XOR of the data bits is 1 when the number of 1s is odd, so appending P = A⊕B⊕C makes the total number of 1s even.

questions.q: When a form is submitted with method="GET", the form data is:
options: sent only in the request body
appended to the URL as a query string
questions.exp: GET appends name=value pairs to the URL after '?'.

questions.q: Which sensor is commonly used to measure the intensity of ambient light?
questions.exp: An LDR changes its resistance with incident light; the others sense temperature, magnetic field and pressure/vibration.

questions.q: How many of the 8 possible input combinations of a 3-input XOR gate produce output 1?
questions.exp: A multi-input XOR is 1 when an odd number of inputs are 1: C(3,1) + C(3,3) = 3 + 1 = 4.

questions.q: To convert a D flip-flop into a T flip-flop, the D input must be driven by
questions.exp: T flip-flop has Q+ = T ⊕ Q and D flip-flop has Q+ = D, so D = T ⊕ Q.

questions.q: Which of the following is always achievable for any relation schema?
options: A lossless, dependency-preserving decomposition into BCNF
A lossless and dependency-preserving decomposition into 3NF
A decomposition into 5NF that preserves all dependencies
questions.exp: The 3NF synthesis algorithm always gives a lossless, dependency-preserving 3NF decomposition; BCNF cannot always preserve dependencies.

questions.q: Which of the following resources is shared by all threads of the same process?
options: The heap memory and global variables
questions.exp: Threads share code, data, heap and open files; each thread has its own stack, program counter and registers.
*p refers to x itself, so x becomes 7 + 3 = 10.

questions.q: Schedule S: r1(A) w1(A) r2(A) w2(A) r1(B) w1(B). Which is correct?
options: It is conflict serializable and equivalent to the serial order T1 then T2
It is conflict serializable and equivalent to the serial order T2 then T1
It is serializable only if T2 commits first
questions.exp: The only conflicts are on A, where T1's operations precede T2's, giving the single edge T1 → T2. No cycle, so serial order T1, T2.

questions.q:
What is the output?
printf("%d", !5 || 7 && 0);
questions.exp: !5 = 0 and 7 && 0 = 0 (&& binds tighter than ||), so 0 || 0 = 0.

questions.q: In the 8086, CS = 2000H and IP = 0150H. What is the physical address of the next instruction?
questions.exp: Physical address = CS x 16 + IP = 20000H + 0150H = 20150H.

questions.q: TLB hit ratio is 80%, TLB lookup takes 20 ns and a memory access takes 100 ns (single-level page table). What is the effective access time?
A hash table of size 7 uses double hashing with h1(k) = k mod 7 and h2(k) = 5 - (k mod 5), and probe i position (h1 + i·h2) mod 7. Key 10 is inserted first, then key 17. In which slot is 17 placed?
questions.exp: 10 goes to slot 3. For 17: h1=3 (occupied), h2 = 5-2 = 3, so next slot = (3+3) mod 7 = 6.

questions.q: A DFA over {0,1} has states A (start), B, C, D, E; final states D and E. Transitions: A: 0→B, 1→C; B: 0→D, 1→E; C: 0→D, 1→E; D: 0→D, 1→D; E: 0→E, 1→E. How many states does the minimal equivalent DFA have?
questions.exp: B≡C (same behaviour) and D≡E (both accepting traps), giving classes {A}, {B,C}, {D,E} = 3 states.

questions.q: Which exception is raised by the statement int('12.5')?
questions.exp: The argument is a string of the wrong format for int, which raises ValueError.

questions.q: A circular queue is implemented in an array of size 8 using the convention that the queue is full when (rear + 1) mod 8 = front. What is the maximum number of elements it can hold?
questions.exp: One slot is left unused to distinguish full from empty, so capacity is 8 - 1 = 7.

questions.q: Using basic COCOMO for an organic project, effort E = 2.4 × (KLOC)^1.05 person-months. For a 10 KLOC project the effort is approximately
A directed graph has adjacency lists 1:{2,3}, 2:{4}, 3:{4}, 4:{}. Depth first search starts at vertex 1 and visits neighbours in ascending order. What is the visiting order?
questions.exp: From 1 go to 2, then 4, backtrack to 1 and visit 3 (4 already visited).

questions.q:
Statement I: RISC processors typically use hardwired control. Statement II: CISC processors commonly use microprogrammed control.
Which is correct?
questions.exp: Simple RISC instruction sets allow fast hardwired control, whereas complex CISC instruction sets are usually implemented with microprograms.

questions.q: Head at cylinder 50 moving toward cylinder 0 on a disk with cylinders 0-199; queue 82, 170, 43, 140, 24, 16, 190. What is the total head movement under SCAN?
questions.exp: 50 → 0 costs 50 (servicing 43, 24, 16), then 0 → 190 costs 190; total 240.

questions.q: Which property makes a grammar unsuitable for LL(1) predictive parsing?
options: Presence of terminals on right-hand sides
questions.exp: A left-recursive grammar makes a top-down parser loop forever and is never LL(1).

questions.q: Which of the following statements is NOT true?
questions.exp: (n+1)! = (n+1)·n!, which is not bounded by a constant multiple of n!. The other three hold.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of comparisons needed by binary search to find a key in a sorted array of 1000 elements?
questions.exp: Maximum comparisons = floor(log₂ 1000) + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10.

questions.q: Which statement is correct about method overriding in Java?
options: The overriding method must have a different parameter list
The overriding method may be private when the original is public
The overriding method cannot have a more restrictive access modifier
The call is resolved at compile time
questions.exp: Overriding must keep the same signature and cannot reduce visibility; dispatch is at run time.

questions.q: For a text of length n and a pattern of length m, the worst-case running time of the naive string matching algorithm is
questions.exp: It tries n−m+1 shifts, each needing up to m character comparisons.

questions.q: Which of the following search strategies is NOT guaranteed to find a solution in a search tree of infinite depth?
options: Uniform-cost search with positive step costs
questions.exp: DFS may go down an infinite branch forever and never reach the goal, so it is not complete.

questions.q: A child learns to control the shoulders and arms before the fingers. This illustrates
questions.exp: Proximodistal development proceeds from the centre of the body to the periphery.

questions.q: NEP 2020 recommends public investment in education of:
questions.exp: The policy reiterates the target of 6% of GDP.

questions.q: Skinner's operant conditioning is mainly concerned with:
questions.exp: Operant conditioning shapes voluntary behaviour by its consequences (reinforcement/punishment).

questions.q: Learners who prefer diagrams and charts are mainly
questions.exp: A preference for seeing information is the visual style.

questions.q: A seminar is best described as:
options: a one-way lecture by an expert
a group meeting where papers are presented and discussed under guidance
a written test with objective questions
a practical session in the laboratory
questions.exp: In a seminar participants present prepared papers followed by interaction.

questions.q: Which is the most important quality of an effective counsellor?
questions.exp: Empathic listening builds trust and rapport.

questions.q: Thorndike's Law of Readiness states that
options: learning is more effective when the learner is prepared to act
questions.exp: When a conduction unit is ready to act, acting is satisfying.

questions.q: In CCE, the word 'comprehensive' means that the evaluation covers:
options: only the subjects in the examination
both scholastic and co-scholastic aspects of the learner's development
questions.exp: Comprehensive evaluation assesses overall development, including attitudes and skills.

questions.q: Using praise such as 'Very good' and a nod for a correct answer is the skill of:
questions.exp: Positive verbal and non-verbal responses strengthen desired behaviour.

questions.q: Who generally conducts action research?
options: The practising teacher in his or her own class
questions.exp: Teachers research their own problems.

questions.q: A student reads novels purely for the joy of reading. This is
questions.exp: Intrinsic motivation comes from interest or enjoyment of the activity itself.

questions.q: Block-based languages like Scratch are useful for beginners because they:
options: are the only way to learn programming
remove syntax errors and focus on logic
are faster than every other language
questions.exp: Drag-and-drop blocks help novices concentrate on concepts.

questions.q: Producing ideas from many different categories shows
questions.exp: Flexibility is the ability to shift categories or approaches.

questions.q: Difficulty in handwriting and expressing thoughts in writing is called
questions.exp: Dysgraphia is a writing disability.

questions.q: A test that adequately covers the syllabus content has high:
questions.exp: Content validity is judged by how well the test represents the subject content.

questions.q: The id operates on the
questions.exp: The id seeks immediate gratification of instincts.

questions.q: The 5E instructional model consists of Engage, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate and:
questions.exp: The sequence is Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate.

questions.q: Which age range corresponds to Piaget's concrete operational stage?
questions.exp: Concrete operational thinking develops at roughly 7-11 years.

questions.q: A student says, 'I will not copy in the exam because rules must be followed to keep society in order.' This is
options: conventional level, law and order orientation
questions.exp: Respect for rules and social order is Stage 4 of the conventional level.

questions.q: The term 'null curriculum' refers to:
options: what the school does not teach but could have
questions.exp: Eisner used it for content and skills that are left out.

questions.q: Which of the following is a non-projected visual aid?
questions.exp: Charts, models and maps are shown directly without projection.

questions.q: Repeated presentation of the conditioned stimulus without the unconditioned stimulus leads to
questions.exp: The conditioned response gradually weakens and disappears.

questions.q: Dysgraphia is a learning difficulty related to:
questions.exp: Dysgraphia affects handwriting and written expression.

questions.q: Erikson's 'identity crisis' is mainly associated with
questions.exp: Adolescents struggle with who they are and what role to adopt.

questions.q: Vygotsky regarded 'private speech' (children talking to themselves) as
options: a form of egocentric speech that must be stopped
a tool for thinking and self-regulation that later becomes inner speech
a proof of lack of intelligence
questions.exp: For Vygotsky self-talk guides problem-solving and gradually becomes silent inner speech.

questions.q: NPTEL provides:
options: video and web courses in engineering and science through IITs and IISc
questions.exp: NPTEL is a joint initiative of the IITs and IISc.

questions.q: Spearman's two-factor theory proposed
options: a general factor (g) and specific factors (s)
questions.exp: Spearman held that all tasks involve g plus task-specific s.

questions.q: Which of the following is a supply-type (recall) item?
questions.exp: Supply-type items require the student to produce the answer.

questions.q: Which crisis is typical of the school-age years of 6 to 12?
questions.exp: Children learn skills and either feel competent (industry) or inadequate (inferiority).

questions.q: Corporal punishment of children in schools is prohibited by:
options: The Indian Penal Code only for adults
questions.exp: Section 17 prohibits physical punishment and mental harassment.

questions.q: Major Dhyan Chand, regarded as a legend of Indian sport, was associated with which game?
questions.exp: Dhyan Chand won three Olympic golds (1928, 1932, 1936) in hockey; his birthday is National Sports Day.

questions.q: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre at Amritsar took place in
questions.exp: General Dyer ordered firing on 13 April 1919 (Baisakhi day).

questions.q: Chilika Lake, the largest brackish-water lagoon in India, is located in which state?
questions.exp: Chilika Lake lies on the coast of Odisha along the Bay of Bengal.

questions.q: Which river is called the 'Sorrow of Bihar' because of its frequent floods?
questions.exp: The Kosi shifts its course often and causes recurrent floods in north Bihar.

questions.q: Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution by which Amendment?
questions.exp: The 42nd Amendment (1976), on the Swaran Singh Committee's recommendation, added Part IV-A.

questions.q: The major component of biogas is
questions.exp: Biogas, produced by anaerobic decomposition of organic matter, contains about 55-65% methane.

questions.q: Project Tiger was launched in India in the year

questions.q: Which was the first biosphere reserve of India, established in 1986?
questions.exp: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve was the first in India, covering parts of Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka.

questions.q: Which statutory body at the national level is headed by the Prime Minister under the Disaster Management Act, 2005?
questions.exp: NDMA, established under the 2005 Act, has the Prime Minister as chairperson.

questions.exp: Sudden vertical displacement of the sea floor during undersea earthquakes generates tsunami waves.

questions.q: If 6 workers build a wall in 10 days, how many days will 4 workers (working at the same rate) take?
questions.exp: Work = 6 x 10 = 60 worker-days; days for 4 workers = 60/4 = 15 (inverse proportion).

questions.q: How many bricks of size 20 cm x 10 cm x 6 cm are needed to build a wall 12 m long, 20 cm thick and 3 m high? (ignore mortar)
questions.exp: Wall volume = 1200 x 20 x 300 = 7,200,000 cm³; brick volume = 1200 cm³; number = 7,200,000/1200 = 6000.

options: SSA (two sides and a non-included angle)
questions.exp: SSA does not guarantee congruence in general; SAS, ASA and SSS are valid criteria (RHS is valid only for right triangles).

questions.q: Find the missing number: 2 → 6, 3 → 12, 4 → 20, 5 → 30, 8 → ?
questions.exp: The rule is n × (n + 1): 8 × 9 = 72.

questions.q: Which of the following is the odd one out?
questions.exp: Mercury, Venus and Mars are planets, whereas the Moon is a natural satellite.

questions.q:
Statements: All roses are flowers. All flowers are plants.
Conclusions: I. All roses are plants. II. Some plants are flowers.
questions.exp: I follows by the chain rose → flower → plant. Since all flowers are plants, at least some plants are flowers, so II also follows.
